data.explanation: Your landlord's property management company has given formal notice to end your tenancy on 28 February 2027, saying the owner, Herr Olaf Exempeldüne, wants to move into the apartment himself (Eigenbedarf). German law gives you the right to object (Widerspruch) under §§ 574–574b BGB if moving out would be an undue hardship for you or your family, but the written objection must reach the landlord by a deadline the app will show you. If you don't object in time, you are expected to vacate by 28 February 2027. A move-out inspection (Wohnungsabnahme) will be proposed for February. Given what's at stake, consider getting advice from a tenants' association (Mieterverein) or lawyer before the deadline.

items.title: Decide whether to object to the termination (Widerspruch einlegen)
items.action: If moving out would be an undue hardship for you or your family, submit a written objection (Widerspruch in Textform) to the Hausverwaltung asking to continue the tenancy.
items.consequence: If you do not object by the deadline, you lose the right to contest the termination and are expected to move out by 28 February 2027.

items.quote: Der Widerspruch bedarf der Textform und muss mir spätestens zwei Monate vor dem Ende des Mietverhältnisses zugehen.

items.title: Expect the move-out inspection (Wohnungsabnahme)
items.action: Watch for the landlord's proposed date in February 2027 for the move-out inspection (Wohnungsabnahme) and arrange to attend it.
items.quote: Einen Termin zur Wohnungsabnahme schlagen wir Ihnen im Februar vor.

data.summary: Hausverwaltung Beispielbodden GmbH, acting on behalf of the owner Herr Olaf Exempeldüne, gives formal notice ending the tenant's tenancy of the apartment at Strandstraße 3, Whg. 4, effective 28 February 2027, because the owner wants to move back into the apartment himself (Eigenbedarf). The notice was personally delivered on 18 November 2026 at 11 am.
